Name: Armory Cabinet
Author: Poplinp
Description:
[b][color=#d5a6bd][size=4]-- Features
[/size][/color][/b][list]
[*]Store your weapons, trinkets and rings - perfect for collecting those rare but not useful ones :)
[*]Infinite storage, similar to a dresser - free up chest space from unstackable weapons & trinkets!
[/list][color=#d5a6bd]
[size=3][b]    -- NEW TO V2:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*] 4 different cabinet options, including narrow variants.
[*]You can now store rings in the cabinet.
[*]Weapon tabs are separated by type: swords, clubs and daggers.
[/list]

[color=#d5a6bd][size=4][b]-- Obtain in-game[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Buy from the Adventurer's Guild for 5000g.
[*]Via the Furniture Catalogue for free.
[/list]

[color=#d5a6bd][size=4][b]-- Notes[/b][/size][/color]
Starting with V2, this mod now includes an additional small SMAPI mod for logic. This really shouldn't matter but if you see 2 mods in your SMAPI log (ArmoryCabinet and [FF] Armory Cabinet) that's why :)

[size=2]
